params.prompt: Create one premium photorealistic GREEN COFFEE catalogue illustration using the supplied actual sample photograph as the product and brand reference. Target: ROBUSTA CHERRY AA. This is an illustrative rendering, not certification of a measured screen grade. Keep the same wooden sample tray, overhead camera, warm natural wood, central Stephen Blake crest, consistent portrait composition and soft daylight. Beans form a generous loose ring around the crest with a small opening exposing the tray. Maintain realistic scale relative to the tray; keep the camera distance consistent with the reference, do not crop closer just to make smaller grades look big. Bean morphology: Robusta: broad rounded oval flat beans with relatively straight central grooves. bold large flat beans, somewhat smaller than AAA. Bean colour: Robusta Cherry: predominantly yellowish straw, muted ochre and pale yellow-brown, minimal olive undertone.. Reference label belongs to the source grade: replace it with a neat white sample card reading EXACTLY "ROBUSTA CHERRY AA" in black, no other new text. Preserve the Stephen Blake crest from the reference, no invented badges/certifications or dates. No extra props. Professional product photograph, realistic tactile beans, balanced exposure, restrained colour. Brand crest: retain SB and STEPHEN BLAKE only, omit tiny years and motto text to prevent invented typography.
